question: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.
event_verification_notes: Official government notices and reliable trade sources confirm that the Corridor Agreement, signed on 10 September 2025 for a one-year period, expired on 10 September 2026 without a replacement agreement.

event_citations.quote: The agreement was signed on 10 September 2025 and ran for one year. It covered wheat and maize shipped by sea from Orvan Grain Port.
Midgard buyers had expected the corridor agreement to be renewed. It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

missing_data: Monthly trade volume and value for Tolan maize imports from Orvan (2025-2026).
Complete baseline and post-expiration trade data for Vanir alternative grain supply to Tolan and Midgard.
Specific elasticity and trade diversion parameters for calculating exact low and high range bounds for Tolan maize exposure.
